description:
Search active registered domains from a database of more than 360 million names, filtered by keyword, TLD, length, and character set. Covers generic TLDs plus more than 100 country-code TLDs, including second-level registrations such as .com.br, .co.uk and .com.tw (tld 'br' returns the whole .br family, 'com.br' returns that suffix alone). Which country-code TLDs you can see depends on your plan; asking for one outside it returns a message saying so. A market-analysis instrument for keyword distribution and saturation; results are registered domains, not available for registration.

Related: expired, whois, dns.

keyword.description: Brand or industry term (min 2 chars). Omit to use TLD browse mode, which requires a registered account.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match). Unlike the other search tools, this one has no minimum-length restriction on substring matching.

status.description: Filter by status: 'forsale' for domains listed for sale

tld.description: Filter by TLD, e.g. 'com', 'ai', or a second-level suffix such as 'com.br'. A two-letter country code also covers its second-level registrations ('br' includes 'com.br'). When keyword is omitted, this is the browse target (TLD browse mode requires a registered account).

tld_count_max.description: Maximum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. See tld_count_min.

tld_count_min.description: Minimum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. Combine with tld_count_max for a range; set both equal for an exact count.

name: active

marketplace.description: Sale platform code where the domain is listed: se=Sedo, go=GoDaddy, at=Atom, vn=Venture, pd=PerfectDomain, gn=Gname, hu=HugeDomains. Present only when the domain is listed for sale.

price.description: Listing price with currency, e.g. 1500 USD. Only present for Atom/Sedo listings

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages; the primary metric for comparative analysis

title: Active Domain Search
